physical_checks: Monitor first-layer attachment, including the paddle and separate fittings. Cut the sacrificial ties at their solid roots before removing the carrier.

Slide the real carbon rod through the carrier. Try the standard pin first, support the paddle, then fit the rear clip and check click travel with the lead installed. The snug alternative has only 0.033 mm modelled path clearance.
Fit the wired OP1 from below with the removable switch out, install the lid, and check all four prewired sockets by hand. Check battery retention and removal without squeezing the pouch.
Check guard feel, root strength, collet grip and service access on the real assembly.
